```{r}
library(tidyverse)

library(ggbeeswarm)
```

Panel A Signature attribution
```{r}
# load reference signatures (COSMIC v3.5)
ref.sigs <- ICAMS::ReadCatalog("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/COSMIC_Human_SBS-96_GRCh38_v3.6.tsv")
ref.sigs <- ICAMS::as.catalog(ref.sigs,
                              ref.genome = "GRCh38",
                              region = "genome",
                              catalog.type = "counts.signature")

# The Duplex Sequencing only targets a small part of the human genome
# calculate the trinucleotide composition of the DS target region
# and adjust the reference signatures to take this difference into account
DS.target.BED<-ICAMS:::ReadBedRanges("/mnt/storage/peter/steve_aa/AA_normal_blood_tumors_DS_WGS_singleCells_SteveRozen_Arnoud/TwinstrandDraft/Supplementary/Supplemental_code/input/Twinstrand.bed")
DS_abundance<-ICAMS:::GetCustomKmerCounts(k = 3,
                                          ref.genome = "GRCh38",
                                          custom.ranges = DS.target.BED)
DS_abundance<-ICAMS:::Collapse192AbundanceTo96(DS_abundance[,1])
ref.sigs.DS<-ICAMS::TransformCatalog(ref.sigs,
                                     target.ref.genome = NULL,
                                     target.region = "unknown",
                                     target.catalog.type = "counts.signature",
                                     target.abundance = DS_abundance)

## Cosmic signature from de novo signature decomposition
prior.sigs <- c("SBS1", "SBS5", "SBS22a", "SBS39", "SBS40a", "SBS100") 

input_file <- "/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/matGen/ds_filtered/output/SBS/UC_AA.SBS96.all"
input_catalog <- ICAMS::ReadCatalog(file = input_file)

## Signature attribution with mSigAct
sparseAssign <- SparseAssignActivity(spectra = input_catalog,
                                     sigs = ref.sigs[,prior.sigs],
                                     max.level = length(prior.sigs)-1,
                                     p.thresh = 0.05/length(prior.sigs),
                                     num.parallel.samples = 5,
                                     mc.cores.per.sample = 20,
                                     drop.low.mut.samples = FALSE,
                                     seed = 425,
                                     output.dir = "/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/mSigAct/dsnogermline_uc_cosmic_updatedarnoud_noSBS31")
# save(sparseAssign, file = "/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/mSigAct//dsnogermline_uc_cosmic_updatedarnoud_noSBS31.rda")

## Load mSigAct result
load("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/mSigAct/dsnogermline_uc_cosmic_updatedarnoud_noSBS31.rda")

## Mutation count 
assignment_tmb <- sparseAssign$proposed.assignment %>% t() %>% as.data.frame()

## Signature attribution result
assignment_res <- sparseAssign$proposed.assignment %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  sweep(1, rowSums(.), "/") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(.x < 0.05, 0, .x))) %>%
  sweep(1, rowSums(.), "/") %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Samples")

## Process data for plotting
mSigAct_pd <- assignment_res %>% gather(data = ., key = "signatures", value = "value", -Samples) %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(grepl(pattern = "_Kidney", x = Samples) ~ "DN",
                          grepl(pattern = "_Blood", x = Samples) ~ "B",
                          grepl(pattern = "_Urine", x = Samples) ~ "U",
                          grepl(pattern = "T", x = Samples) ~ "T",
                          grepl(pattern = "N", x = Samples) ~ "AN"),
         group = paste0("UC", as.numeric(str_extract(Samples, "\\d+"))),
         method = "mSigAct") %>%
  dplyr::filter(type %in% c("T", "AN", "DN"))

## Manual update cause UC7N is really DN and UC4N is DN
mSigAct_pd[which(mSigAct_pd$group == "UC7" & mSigAct_pd$type == "AN"), "type"] <- "DN"
mSigAct_pd[which(mSigAct_pd$group == "UC4" & mSigAct_pd$type == "AN"), "type"] <- "DN"

## Factor level
sample.order <- c("UC2", "UC4", "UC5", "UC7", "UC10", "UC11", "UC13", "UC14", "UC18", "UC19", "UC26", "UC34")
mSigAct_pd$group <- factor(x = mSigAct_pd$group, levels = sample.order)
mSigAct_pd$type <- factor(x = mSigAct_pd$type, levels = c("T", "AN", "DN"))
mSigAct_pd$signatures <- factor(x = mSigAct_pd$signatures, 
                                levels = c("SBS1",  "SBS5", "SBS22a", "SBS39", "SBS40a", "SBS100"))

## Col annotation
sbs.color2 <- c("#5A5A5A", "#9E9E9E", "#A020F0", "#E6AB02", "#7A7A7A", "#1B9E77")
names(sbs.color2) <- c("SBS1", "SBS5", "SBS22a", "SBS100", "SBS40a", "SBS39")

p20 <- ggplot(data = mSigAct_pd, aes(x = type, y = value, fill = signatures)) + 
  geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sbs.color2) +
  ylab("Proportion") +
  facet_grid2(. ~ group, scales = "free", space = "free", switch = "x",
              strip = strip_themed(
              text_x = list(
                element_text(color = "black", face = "bold", size = 6, margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1))
              ))) +
  theme_bw() +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, margin = margin(t = -11)),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 5),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 5),
        panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#D3D3D3", linewidth = 0.2),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position = c(0.9, 0.95),
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.justification = c(1, 0))

p20
```

Panel B Dumbbell - Attribution from WGS to DS
```{r}
## DS attribution result
load("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/mSigAct/dsnogermline_uc_cosmic_updatedarnoud_noSBS31.rda")
ds_res <- sparseAssign$proposed.assignment %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  sweep(1, rowSums(.), "/") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(.x < 0.05, 0, .x))) %>%
  sweep(1, rowSums(.), "/") %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Samples") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl(pattern = "Blood|Urine", x = Samples)) %>%
  gather(data = ., key = "signatures", value = "value", -Samples) %>%
  mutate(method = "DS")

## SBS attribution result
wgs_res <- data.table::fread("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/data/spe/wgs_uc/SBS96/Suggested_Solution/COSMIC_SBS96_Decomposed_Solution/Activities/COSMIC_SBS96_Activities.txt") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "Samples") %>%
  sweep(1, rowSums(.), "/") %>% ## Normalize
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ ifelse(.x < 0.05, 0, .x))) %>% ## Anything 0.05 set to and renormalize
  sweep(1, rowSums(.), "/") %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Samples") %>%
  mutate(type = case_when(grepl(pattern = "_", x = Samples) ~ "ON",
                          grepl(pattern = "T", x = Samples) ~ "T",
                          grepl(pattern = "N", x = Samples) ~ "AN"),
         group = paste0("UC", as.numeric(str_extract(Samples, "\\d+"))),
         Samples = paste0(group, type)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Samples != "UC7AN") %>% ## DS samples are kidney sample not ureter. 
  mutate(Samples = gsub(pattern = "AN|ON", replacement = "N", x = Samples)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-type, -group) %>%
  gather(data = ., key = "signatures", value = "value", -Samples) %>%
  mutate(method = "WGS")

## Combine WGS and DS results and format to Long
combined_res <- rbind(ds_res, wgs_res) %>%
  dplyr::filter(signatures == "SBS22a") %>%
  dplyr::select(-signatures) %>%
  mutate(group = gsub(pattern = "T|N", replacement = "", x = Samples),
         type = ifelse(grepl(pattern = "T", x = Samples), "T", "N"))

## Factor order
samp.order <- combined_res %>% dplyr::filter(method == "DS") %>% pull(Samples)
combined_res$Samples <- factor(x = combined_res$Samples, levels = rev(samp.order))
combined_res$group <- factor(x = combined_res$group, levels = c("UC2", "UC4", "UC5", "UC7", "UC10", "UC11",
                                                                "UC13", "UC14", "UC18", "UC19", "UC26", "UC34"))
combined_res$method <- factor(x = combined_res$method, levels = c("WGS", "DS"))
combined_res$type <- factor(x = combined_res$type, levels = c("N", "T"))
combined_res <- combined_res %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(method), type, .by_group = TRUE)

## Map for alternating grey and white background based on patient
bg <- data.frame(
  group = unique(levels(combined_res$group)),
  fill = rep(c("grey80", "white"),
             length.out = length(unique(combined_res$group)))
)
bg$group <- factor(x = bg$group, levels = c("UC2", "UC4", "UC5", "UC7", "UC10", "UC11",
                                            "UC13", "UC14", "UC18", "UC19", "UC26", "UC34"))

## Color annotation
color_anno <- c('firebrick3', 'steelblue')
names(color_anno) <- c("WGS", "DS")

## Building arrow and segment for ggplot
offset <- 0.01
seg_df <- combined_res %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(group, type),
    names_from = method,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  filter(WGS != DS) %>%
  mutate(
    DS_arrow = DS - sign(DS - WGS) * offset
  )

p1 <- ggplot(data = combined_res, aes(x = value, y = type)) +
  geom_rect(data = bg, inherit.aes = FALSE,
    aes(xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf,
        ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
        fill = fill), 
    alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(0.5, 2), guide = "none") +
  geom_point(aes(color = method, size = value), alpha = 0.5, stroke = 0) +
  geom_segment(data = seg_df, aes(x = WGS, xend = DS_arrow, 
                                  y = type, yend = type),
               linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey30",
               arrow = arrow(type = "closed",
                             length = unit(0.5, "mm"))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_anno) +
  facet_grid(group ~., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  xlab("SBS22a Attribution") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.position = c(0.85, 1),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"),
        legend.justification = c(1, 0),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y = element_text(size = 6, angle = 0, hjust = 0),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(), 
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8))

p1
```

sbs39 enriched in tumors
```{r}
sbs39 <- ds_res %>% dplyr::filter(signatures == "SBS39") %>%
  mutate(type = ifelse(grepl(pattern = "T", x = Samples), "T", "N"))

tab <- table(sbs39$type, sbs39$value > 0)

fisher.test(tab, alternative = "greater")
```

sbs100 no specificity. possible artifact of duplex
```{r}
sbs100 <- ds_res %>% dplyr::filter(signatures == "SBS100") %>%
  mutate(type = ifelse(grepl(pattern = "T", x = Samples), "T", "N"))

table(sbs100$type, sbs100$value > 0)

binom.test(11, 24, p = 0.9, alternative = "greater")
```

Panel C Comparing again WGS and DS but at normal and tumor level
```{r}
## Factor order
combined_res$type <- factor(x = combined_res$type, levels = c("T", "N"))

## Color annotation
type_anno <- c("#A6A6A6", "#4F81BD")
names(type_anno) <- c("N", "T")

p3 <- ggplot(combined_res, aes(x = type, y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.35, outlier.shape = NA,
               alpha = 0.6,
               fill = "grey80") +
  geom_line(aes(group = group), color = "black", linewidth = 0.15, alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_quasirandom(aes(fill = type), shape = 21, size = 1, width = 0.1,
    color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = type_anno, guide = "none") +
  facet_grid(method ~., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  ylab("SBS22a Attribution") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
        panel.spacing = unit(3, "pt"))
```
